goal: Improve ordinary houses and normal transactions, not only extreme low-price large homes
baseline: frozen v4 four base model families at 25% each in log space
historical_data_reuse: All train houses have appeared in earlier diagnostics; nested fits prevent within-run label leakage but do not make the data newly untouched. Screening uses original1168 seed42.
candidate_shortlist_rule: At most two kernel and two tree configs from screen, plus at most two target-encoded configs. Screen shortlist favors v4 graft improvement on ordinary and Normal rows and does not use outer folds.

recipe_grid.new_components: each shortlisted model separately; equal kernel/tree or all-new average if >=2 candidates

inner_selection_rule.metrics: all rows log-RMSE, non-extreme diagnostic log-RMSE, Normal transaction log-RMSE
inner_selection_rule.training_extreme_rule: GrLivArea>4000 and SalePrice<300000; used only to define diagnostics, validation samples never removed
inner_selection_rule.eligibility: all RMSE <= baseline+0.0005; ordinary and Normal each improve >=0.00015
inner_selection_rule.fallback: frozen v4 if no eligible recipe
inner_selection_rule.tie_rule: within 0.00005 prefer lower graft weight, then fewer new components

release_gate: nested mean all RMSE <= baseline+0.0003 and mean ordinary and Normal RMSE each below baseline; report all five folds per repeat plus per-house error contributions and year slices. If this fails do not label as a validated improvement.
final_selection: same inner selection rule on all1460 rows, 3-fold seed24501, no choice based on test prediction tails or leaderboard scores
full_training: all1460 train rows; stochastic chosen components average seeds42/2026/137, deterministic fit once

pre_outer_revision.timing: after historical screening results, before any new outer fit/results
pre_outer_revision.basis: SVR ordinary-house gains broad, but extreme-area extrapolation regresses; test feature-only applicability taper rather than a label/Id exception
pre_outer_revision.gate: For each actual fit subset compute GrLivArea q95 and q99; predict gate clip((q99-area)/(q99-q95),0,1), if equal use indicator area<=q95. Apply common gate to kernel or kernel-containing average graft. Ungated recipes remain inner candidates.
pre_outer_revision.outer_uses: Evaluate automatic inner recipe selector only; no choice of gate/weights after viewing outer outcomes
pre_outer_revision.baseline_bagging: CatBoost averages full frozen seeds42,2026,137 at every CV fit; final frozen v4 file reused exactly
